title: The Placebo Effect: How Belief Becomes Biology
question: How can an inert sugar pill relieve real pain, and what does that reveal about the link between expectation and the body?
summary: Placebos trigger the brain's own opioids and dopamine, shape pain through expectation, and work even when patients know they are fake. This exploration separates the real effect from statistical illusion and looks at nocebo and the ethics of honest placebos.
